Map Survey Files step of the Load Data wizard

Source: R/wizard-mapping_steps.R
map_survey_ui.Rd

The user matches each admin level 1 name of the dataset to the name the regional survey uses for the same area. A button opens the matching dialog (mapping_modal_ui()); saving it stores the mapping with cache()$set_survey_mapping(). The regional survey is the one the user uploaded, or the built-in one for the country, so the step can always be done. Once a mapping is saved, a "clear mapping" button removes it (cache()$clear_survey_mapping()) and a banner says how the names were matched (mapping_provenance_banner()). The step counts as complete when a mapping is saved (see step_survey_mapping_complete()), which needs the user to save the dialog at least once.

Usage

map_survey_ui(id, i18n)

map_survey_server(id, cache, i18n)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

Value

map_survey_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: a card. map_survey_server() is called for its side effects and returns nothing useful.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in the server of the Load Data screen, where `cache` is a reactive holding the dataset:
# the step's page, for wizard_steps_server(), and its server
panel <- list(key = "survey_mapping", ui = map_survey_ui(ns("map_survey"), i18n))
map_survey_server("map_survey", cache, i18n)
} # }
